This protein-packed lunch today 👌Red rice, peanutbutter tofu and kale with lots of garlic💚 So much goodness in one bowl!😍😍😍
•
It has been getting dark so early in Estonia these days, so making a decent IG picture has been a real challenge. But I just had to share this quick recipe with you guys🙈
•
You’ll need: • red rice
• kale
• firm tofu • peanutbutter
• soy sauce

Just cook some red rice in a pot; wash the kale and pick the stems away, cook the soft leafy parts on a pan with garlic or garlic salt; cut the tofu into little cubes, fry them until golden. Mix a tablespoon of tofu with some soy sauce and add the dressing to the tofu cubes. Then mix it all together. Super easy and perfect for a post workout meal☺️

uthorities in Northern California say the parents of two boys found inside cages bolted to a bedroom wall have been arrested for child endangerment. Modoc County Sheriff Tex Dowdy said Tuesday deputies arrested 25-year-old Ramon Zendejas and his girlfriend, 25-year-old Mercadies Williams on Friday after deputies found the boys in the cages. Dowdy says deputies went to the home in Tulelake to execute a search warrant for illegal firearms when they found the boys under 2 years old inside two cribs that were stacked on top of each other and attached to the wall. He says deputies also found three guns, ammunition and evidence of a butane honey oil lab. The boys were turned over to social services and Zendejas and Williams were arrested on illegal firearms possession and child endangerment charges.

Roast pork with plums
Serves 5

Ingredients: 1Kg clear fillet pork
5 dried plums from our garden
¼ teaspoon salt
¼ teaspoon pepper
1 teaspoon English herbs ready-mix


Preparation :
1. Make a hole in the pork and stuff the plums
2. Fry it for a little while so the juice will stay in the meat
3. Rub the meat with the herbs the salt and the pepper and wrap it in aluminium foil
4. Put in a tray and roast for 1¼ hr at 200º


Baked potatoes
Serves 5

Ingredients: 10 potatoes
salt
¼ teaspoon pepper
3 garlic cloves


Preparation :
1. Cut the potatoes in quarters
2. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 5 mins
3. Place the potatoes in a tray and sprinkle the salt the pepper and grinded garlic
4. Bake for 40mins at 180º


Boiled red cabbage
Serves 5

Ingredients: ½Kg red cabbage
¼ teaspoon salt
¼ teaspoon black pepper
The juice of one lemon
1 apple
1 cup sultanas


Preparation :
1. Shred the cabbage
2. Boil the cabbage for 5mins
3. Let it cool down
4. Grind the apple
5. Mix the cabbage with the other ingredients
